module.purpose: This file automatically schedules a one-hour email reminder for eligible Gmail attendees when no suitable pre-event attendee email workflow already exists.
module.summary: The module inspects booking event data and configured workflows, suppresses processing during dry runs or platform no-email scenarios, and creates a fixed reminder workflow for Gmail attendees when appropriate. It uses distributed tracing and reporting wrappers to provide observability while isolating scheduling failures from the surrounding booking flow.
module.businessContext:
This supports reliable attendee reminders in the booking experience, particularly for Gmail recipients without an existing qualifying workflow.
Failure can leave eligible attendees without timely reminders before their scheduled events.
classes: NewBookingEventType (~L12-12): Unifies default and database-derived event type shapes for reminder scheduling.
functions: _scheduleMandatoryReminder (~L14-95): Detects eligible bookings and schedules one-hour attendee email reminders.
scheduleMandatoryReminder (~L97-100): Reports and invokes mandatory reminder scheduling with standardized observability.

io: Creates a distributed tracing span and obtains a tracing logger.
network: Schedules a one-hour email reminder for filtered Gmail attendees.

assumptions.description: evt provides title, attendees, and organizer.id; each attendee provides an email.
Each workflow provides trigger, nullable time, timeUnit, and steps with optional action values.
isPlatformNoEmail and isDryRun default to false when omitted.
traceContext is supplied by the caller for distributed tracing.
A qualifying workflow must be BEFORE_EVENT, within the inclusive time thresholds, and email attendees.

moduleContractTests.scenario: A mandatory reminder scheduling request is executed as a dry run.
moduleContractTests.when: scheduleMandatoryReminder({ evt, workflows, requiresConfirmation, hideBranding, seatReferenceUid, isDryRun: true, traceContext })
moduleContractTests.rationale: Dry runs must not create reminders.

moduleContractTests.scenario: A platform event is configured not to send email.
moduleContractTests.when: scheduleMandatoryReminder({ evt, workflows, requiresConfirmation, hideBranding, seatReferenceUid, isPlatformNoEmail: true, traceContext })
moduleContractTests.rationale: Platform no-email mode must prevent reminder scheduling.

moduleContractTests.scenario: A matching BEFORE_EVENT attendee email workflow already exists within the first twelve hours.
given: workflows.some((workflow) => workflow.trigger === WorkflowTriggerEvents.BEFORE_EVENT && workflow.time !== null && workflow.time <= 12 && workflow.timeUnit === TimeUnit.HOUR && workflow.steps.some((step) => step?.action === WorkflowActions.EMAIL_ATTENDEE))
moduleContractTests.when: scheduleMandatoryReminder({ evt, workflows, requiresConfirmation: false, hideBranding, seatReferenceUid, traceContext })
moduleContractTests.rationale: Existing qualifying workflows must prevent duplicate mandatory reminders.

moduleContractTests.scenario: An unconfirmed booking has Gmail attendees and no qualifying existing workflow.
moduleContractTests.when: scheduleMandatoryReminder({ evt, workflows, requiresConfirmation: false, hideBranding, seatReferenceUid, traceContext })
moduleContractTests.then: scheduleEmailReminder is called with triggerEvent: WorkflowTriggerEvents.BEFORE_EVENT, action: WorkflowActions.EMAIL_ATTENDEE, timeSpan: { time: 1, timeUnit: TimeUnit.HOUR }, template: WorkflowTemplates.REMINDER, and only Gmail attendee addresses in sendTo
moduleContractTests.rationale: The automatic reminder contract is a one-hour Gmail attendee reminder.

moduleContractTests.scenario: A booking requires confirmation even though it has Gmail attendees and no existing workflow.
moduleContractTests.when: scheduleMandatoryReminder({ evt, workflows, requiresConfirmation: true, hideBranding, seatReferenceUid, traceContext })
moduleContractTests.rationale: Mandatory reminders are excluded while confirmation is required.
